task.title: To open an agreement in Conga CLM

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
Check out your agreement document, from the Contracts pane go to Work tab and click the More icon ().
In the menu, click Open in CLM.

postreq.p: A separate browser window is opened and the agreement is loaded in Conga CLM (You may be prompted to log in again to your Conga CLM account in the browser).
